subject: How do I change my website logo?
body: Please explain how to update the logo displayed on my website.

subject: Checkout is failing
body: Customers cannot complete checkout because the page shows an error.

subject: Change website settings
body: How can I change the general settings for my website?

subject: Update contact information
body: Please guide me through updating the contact information displayed on my website.

subject: Website returns an error
body: My website returns a server error whenever I open an important page. How can I troubleshoot it?

subject: Payment integration stopped working
body: Our payment integration stopped working after yesterday's update. Please help us investigate.

subject: Request a booking feature
body: We want to add an online booking feature to our existing website. Please explain how to start this project.

subject: Add a customer dashboard
body: Can your team build a customer dashboard showing account activity and reports?

subject: Integrate an external calendar
body: We need a new calendar integration so customers can book appointments from our website.

subject: Cancel subscription and request refund
body: I want to cancel my subscription and ask whether I qualify for a refund.

subject: Refund for last invoice
body: Please review my last invoice and explain the process for requesting a refund.

subject: Please cancel my plan
body: I no longer need this service. Please explain how I can cancel my current plan.

subject: Disappointed with customer support
body: I contacted support several times but nobody resolved my problem. I am unhappy with this service.

subject: Website broke after an update
body: The latest update broke our website, and we are frustrated that this issue remains unresolved.

subject: Formal complaint about service
body: I am submitting a complaint about repeated service interruptions and the lack of communication.

subject: Quote for website customization
body: Could you provide a quotation for customizing our business website?

subject: Estimate for website redesign
body: We are considering a website redesign. Please share an estimate and explain which details you need from us.

subject: Pricing for custom integration
body: How much would a custom integration cost? We need a quotation before deciding whether to proceed.

subject: Following up on support request
body: I am following up on my previous support request. Is there any update?
conversation_context: The customer previously reported a support issue.

subject: Checking status of my request
body: Could you please let me know the status of the request I sent earlier?
conversation_context: The customer sent an earlier request and is waiting for a response.
